source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
In your Shooting phase, right after the Stormsword siege cannon on this model is given a target, roll a D6 for that target and for each other unit no more than 3" from it, from either army. Each unit whose roll is 5+ is hit by a concussive wave.

Once this model has made all its attacks against the target this phase, each unit hit by a concussive wave takes D3 mortal wounds.
